She's very gentle and goes at her own pace, and also has a soft spot for cute things. The fact that she loves cute and cuddly things also makes it hard for her to depict dark stories and deep conflicts so her scenarios tend to feel like fairy-tales. When left to her own devices, her imagination often runs wild, but her fantasies are usually about cute girls.
